title: Application of 4′-C-α-aminoethoxy-2′-O-methyl-5-propynyl-uridine for antisense therapeutics
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39148-39162
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06376G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yujun Zhou, Hitotaka Sato, Miwa Kawade, Kenji Yamagishi, Yoshihito Ueno
Antisense oligonucleotides containing 4′-C-α-aminoethoxy-2′-O-methyl-5-propynyl-uridine showed superior thermal stability and nuclease resistance and could efficiently activate RNase H-mediated antisense in vitro in the presence of native DNA gaps.
